name: Tidewater Bike Works — bicycle shop in Norfolk, Virginia, United States

what_it_does.text: Tidewater Bike Works is a bicycle shop in Norfolk, Virginia, that sells road, gravel and city bikes and repairs bikes of any brand in its own workshop, usually within two days. It also rents bikes by the day.
